comment: Endless Arena cutscenes (P2 Part 3, the basic arena cutscene set the user asked for): the first visit, the first wave 10 boss, a new best score, and each new 5-wave theme.

steps.text: The Endless Arena
A place between the Upside-Down's rooms where it practices on people. You're people.
Waves come in fives. Each five has a theme. Every fifth wave, you get to rest, rethink, and regret.
It doesn't end. That's the point. See how far you get.
Wave 10
Something remembers you from the story. It got bigger in here.
New best!
Further than ever. The Arena takes notes. So do I.
The Arena rearranges itself for the next five waves.
Between waves, a cart rolls out of the dark on its own. Nobody pushes it. There's a bell.

steps.speaker: narrator
steps.text: Behind the cart: a woman in a coat made of other coats. She smells like rain and pennies.
The Merchant
"Charms for the brave, tonics for the foolish. Same price either way." She taps a sign: COINS ONLY. NO SOULS. (ANYMORE.)
Relics go on one of you. If that one falls, the relic falls with them. Potions and trinkets are used once. Choose like it matters.
The bell. The cart. The coat of coats. "Still breathing? Good. Breathing customers spend more."
The arena goes quiet. Every fifth wave, something big comes, and it never fights fair.
Read what it does before you swing. The narrator will tell you. Once.
Past the last wave, the arena opens onto a clearing. A fire is already burning. Nobody lit it.
There's a cart with a deli sign, a training ring, a rack of gear, and a gate on the far side that hums when you look at it.
Rest. Talk. Spend what you've got. The gate will wait. Mostly.
